name: Mesh to Voxel Generation via AABB-Triangle Intersection
definition: A method to generate a 3D voxel grid from a mesh by determining which voxels intersect with the mesh triangles. It uses an Axis-Aligned Bounding Box (AABB) vs Triangle intersection test based on the Separating Axis Theorem (SAT).
summary: Mesh to Voxel Generation via AABB-Triangle Intersection converts triangle meshes into solid 3D voxel grids using geometric intersection tests in world space, producing watertight volumes unlike hollow shells or rasterization methods.
